fanart_setting_page.section_intro: These settings control both where files go and how the exported filename is built.
fanart_setting_page.source_intro: The inbox page reads unsorted fanart directly from this folder.
fanart_setting_page.include_subfolders_intro: When enabled, Fanart File also scans image files inside every nested folder under the source path.
fanart_setting_page.destination_intro: Processed images are renamed and moved into game folders under this path.
fanart_setting_page.filename_separator_intro: Leave blank for no separator, or use values like _, -, or a space.
fanart_setting_page.date_format_intro: Examples: DDMMYYYY, YYYYMMDD, DDMMYY, YYMMDD, DD-MM-YYYY.
fanart_setting_page.default_sort_intro: This becomes the initial sort order when Fanart File opens.
fanart_setting_page.current_paths_intro: Quick reference for the active fanart workflow.
fanart_setting_page.filename_preview_intro: Example output using the current export settings.
fanart_setting_page.workflow_intro: How the two menu sections connect.
workflow_steps: Save source, destination, and filename settings here.
Open Fanart File from the sidebar.
Stage files by game and character.
Process the queue to rename and move everything into the destination root.

album_setting_page.section_intro: Add as many album roots as you want. Each row also links that path to one root game for Fanart Album filtering.
album_setting_page.row_intro: Connect this album root to one root game before saving.
album_setting_page.follow_sub_from_url_intro: When enabled, Fanart Album uses the first path segment from the current album URL to resolve a subfolder game under the selected root game.
album_setting_page.no_root_games: No root games have been saved yet. Add one in Games Setting first.
album_setting_page.delete_confirm_copy: Remove this album path from the form. Save the page afterward to apply the change to Album Setting.
album_setting_page.default_sort_intro: This becomes the initial sort order when Fanart Album opens.
album_setting_page.configured_intro: These are the album rows currently available in Fanart Album.
album_setting_page.no_paths: No album paths have been saved yet.
album_setting_page.how_it_works_intro: Quick reference for the album menu.
steps: Add one or more album root folders here.
Select the root game that each album path belongs to.
Optionally enable URL subfolder lookup when the first folder in the album URL should map to a subfolder game.
Open Fanart Album from the sidebar.
Switch between album roots and browse subfolders from the right panel.
